tester: weiyf (flashing); remote validation over SSH by Claude Code

tests.item: Draft image SHA-256 matches SHA256SUMS; flashed to microSD with the default sysconfig.txt
tests.evidence: SHA-256 187b5d2c…a5c505 verified after download; card flashed by the tester.

tests.item: Boots to the XFCE desktop; uname -r and os-release match release.json
tests.evidence: systemctl is-system-running = running, no failed units; kernel 6.12.35 PREEMPT_RT; Debian 13 (trixie); XFCE session on seat0, HDMI 1920x1080.

tests.item: First boot applies sysconfig.txt, resizes the root filesystem and removes the file
tests.evidence: Root grown to 25.5 GB; user debian created; config applied and sysconfig.txt removed; hostname Mo62A.

tests.item: Hostname is set before mDNS, discovery and the login screen
tests.evidence: mo-62a-firstboot-install.service is ordered Before avahi-daemon, mo-discover and lightdm; mo62a.local resolved.

tests.item: System files are owned by root (no UID/GID 1000 outside /home)
tests.evidence: Only /boot/firmware matches, a vfat mount with uid=1000,gid=1000 set in /etc/fstab.

tests.item: SSH login with the configured user
tests.evidence: debian@mo62a.local with the configured password; passwordless sudo installed.

tests.item: Discovery answers with the address on the requester route
tests.evidence: Unicast and broadcast MO62A_DISCOVER probes answered in about 50 ms with ip 10.5.30.132 (not 169.254.x or 172.17.0.1) and version V1.1.1.

tests.item: Gigabit Ethernet link and throughput
tests.evidence: 1000 Mb/s full duplex; iperf3 937 Mb/s to the board and 938 Mb/s from the board.

tests.item: Wi-Fi scan
tests.evidence: 48 networks on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz (RTL8821CS, 8821cs driver).

tests.item: Wi-Fi connect
tests.evidence: No access point credentials were provided for the test.

tests.item: Bluetooth controller up and scanning
tests.evidence: Controller powered (Realtek, H5); LE scan listed nearby devices.

tests.item: HDMI output
tests.evidence: HDMI-A-1 connected at 1920x1080; desktop rendered (screenshot kept).

tests.item: Analog and HDMI audio have distinct names
tests.evidence: PipeWire devices 'Mo62A Analog Audio' and 'Mo62A HDMI Audio'; sinks 'Mo62A Headset Output' and 'Mo62A HDMI Output'.

tests.item: Playback to the headset and HDMI outputs
tests.evidence: 2-second 880 Hz tone played to both sinks without error; sound was not listened to remotely.

tests.item: IMX219 detected with the default camera overlay and captures frames
tests.evidence: init-imx219 found imx219 2-0010 at 1920x1080, CAMERA_NAME 'IMX219 camera module (CSI0)'; mo-examples jpeg-capture saved 1920x1080 JPEG frames.

tests.item: H.264 hardware encode and decode start without timeout
tests.evidence: wave5 VDEC in polling mode; 300 frames 1280x720 encoded, then decoded with capture-io-mode=4 in 2.25 s, 0 dropped (run as root).

tests.item: edgeai-demo status
tests.evidence: Exit 0 before camera init and after; lists the UGREEN USB camera and the IMX219 config.

tests.item: NPU demo on the C7x
tests.evidence: edgeai-demo run 2 (YOLOX-nano) with the CSI camera, Python and C++ backends, 40 s each: 329 of 329 nodes offloaded to TIDL.

tests.item: mo-models V1.0.0 benchmark on this image
tests.evidence: benchmark-inference.py, 100 runs after 5 warm-up: YOLOX-nano mean 10.90 ms (V1.1.0 record 10.90), YOLOX-s mean 40.43 ms (40.40); model SHA-256 identical.

tests.item: mo-examples V1.0.0 examples on this image
tests.evidence: python-smoke ran; hello_inference built on the board with CMake and ran (needs -m; the README omits it); jpeg-capture saved frames.

tests.item: mo-tools V1.0.0 board-test automatic items
tests.evidence: 27 items run over SSH: RTC tick and write passed, system, storage (2 GB DDR, SD 89.6/21.7 MB/s), network, HDMI and IMX219 readings returned. tn_usb_enum reported no peripherals although lsusb lists a hub, keyboard, mouse and camera (tool false negative); tn_usb_read had no USB storage; tn_imx219_capture needs a person to watch.

tests.item: SBOM attached; OP-TEE and crypto devices present
tests.evidence: Draft has mo62a-trixie-xfce-V1.1.1.spdx.json (SPDX-2.3, 1814 packages); /dev/tee0 present; SA2UL provides AES-CBC/ECB and SHA-256/512; cryptodev loads on demand and creates /dev/crypto.

notes: The default user is only in the sudo group, so over SSH the video codec, camera and sound devices need sudo; a local desktop session gets them through seat ACLs. Unchanged since V1.1.0.
The clock started at 2026-04-13 before network time sync; the RTC was written during the test.
tee-supplicant is not installed; cryptodev is not loaded at boot.
